purpose: New Level 1 feature assets: stitch activation, unrolling carpet shortcut, embroidered butterfly carrying golden thread
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-ready sprite atlas for the approved Wishweave Wonders mobile game. INPUT REFERENCES 1–3 are the exact approved visual look: reference1 the rolled embroidered carpet, reference2 tiny gold stitch tab, reference3 intricate gold-and-coral butterfly with a gold thread spool suspended beneath. Preserve that ornate high quality tactile crochet and satin embroidery, chunky braided golden borders, warm sunlight from above-left, richly textured teal/coral/plum/gold yarn. This is a transparent asset sheet, NOT a scene and no characters.
FORMAT: landscape 1536x1024, THREE EQUAL COLUMNS and TWO EQUAL ROWS. Six individually isolated objects, aligned row-major, ALL contained within their own cell with LARGE transparent gutters (at least 60px between separate objects; each no more than 360px wide and 360px tall). Transparent ALPHA background absolutely everywhere outside the six objects and inside their open holes. No color background, black backdrop, checkerboard, floor, shadows under objects, gridlines, text, labels, UI, faces, other props. Never connect objects across cells. No glow crossing a cell.
TOP LEFT: a small interactive gold braided STITCH LOOP/TAB, oval golden yarn loop attached to a tiny coral/antique-gold embroidered round rosette base, like the loop by Purl's hand in reference2 and on wall in reference3. Complete object, no wall or hand, no arrow. Open inside loop transparent.
TOP MIDDLE: one ROLLED CARPET shortcut piece like reference1: a short rectangular teal crocheted carpet with coral/cream/gold flower embroidery and gold braided sides, its far end rolled in a horizontal cylinder exposing the CREAM underside with one coral/gold embroidered flower. Slight overhead view from near end toward far roll. Whole rolled segment isolated; no towers/roads. Wide enough to make the roll visible.
TOP RIGHT: SAME carpet piece FULLY FLAT/UNROLLED, teal crocheted rectangle with coral/cream/gold flower pattern and gold braided sides, same camera slight overhead, perspective near edge slightly wider than far edge. No roll; isolated whole rectangle with all4corners visible. Match top-middle pattern.
BOTTOM LEFT: embroidered coral-and-gold BUTTERFLY with wings CLOSED and pressed together upright, side view, like a decorative sleeping embroidery ready to awaken. Four-wing design of reference3, ornate scalloped gold braid and coral/cream fine stitched veins, slim gold yarn body, two delicate gold antennae. NO face/eyes/cute mascot redesign, no spool, no wall.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: EXACT SAME embroidered coral-and-gold BUTTERFLY with four wings OPEN, nearly frontal tilted slightly in flight like reference3. Symmetrical two large upper and two smaller lower wings, same pattern and body/antennae, no face, no eyes, NO spool, no hangingthreads. Highdetail visible embroidery.
BOTTOM RIGHT: EXACT SAME OPEN-WING butterfly CARRYING A GOLDEN THREAD SPOOL beneath it using TWO fine golden yarn hanging loops attached under body and wrapping around spool ends, just as reference3. Entire butterfly and hanging spool fit together within its cell. Spool honey wooden ends and wound bright gold thread, slight tilt. Do not crop antennae, wings, threads, spool. No long trailing strings into neighboringcells. This is ONE isolated composite sprite. The butterfly is decorative and magical, never a third character.
Consistent professional 3D game art materials and the approved exact location's design language. Large enough transparent spacing to crop each object without touching any other. No output labels or watermark.
notes: Atlas pixels are copied unchanged. Individual PNGs are technical rectangular crops using explicit alpha-derived bounds; no color, alpha, or pixel retouching.
Bounds use alpha > 8 plus 2 px padding to avoid nearly invisible generation specks. PNG alpha is preserved.
Sprite art is a 2D production starter, not rigged 3D geometry. Patterns follow approved references but are newly generated individual prop renditions.
Use manifest frames rather than assuming a uniform grid. Frame5 is butterfly with attached golden spool using two hanging gold strings.
